Name: Time Chapter - Enjoy the Moment One Pause at a Time
Author: acharles1
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Time Chapter[/size][/b][/center]
[center][i]Time stands still. Keep playing. Turn the page when you’re ready.[/i][/center]

[center]Playing a heavily modded Stardew Valley?[/center]
[center]Tons of NPCs to meet, crops to water, animals to care for, places to explore, events to catch...[/center]
[center]and somehow the whole day is already gone?[/center]
[center]Maybe you’ve even installed slower-time mods and spent ages tweaking the day length until it almost feels right.[/center]

[center][b]Well, Time Chapter is my answer to that.[/b][/center]
[center]Instead of making the entire day painfully slow, Time Chapter gives you a few natural stopping points throughout the day.[/center]
[center]At [b]11 AM, 3 PM, 7 PM and Midnight[/b], the clock pauses and simply waits for you.[/center]
[center][b]But the valley keeps moving.[/b][/center]
[center]Keep farming.[/center]
[center]Keep fishing.[/center]
[center]Go mining.[/center]
[center]Visit everyone you wanted to see.[/center]
[center]Explore.[/center]
[center]Finish your chores.[/center]
[center]Do absolutely nothing for a while if you want.[/center]
[center]When you’re ready?[/center]
[center][b]Turn the page and continue your day.[/b][/center]
[center]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b]A little support goes a long way.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Endorsements, comments, and feedback help these mods grow and inspire what comes next.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Thanks for being part of it.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[/center]



⏰ [b]WHAT TIME CHAPTER DOES[/b]
[list]
[*]Pauses the Stardew clock at [b]11 AM, 3 PM, 7 PM and Midnight[/b][/*]
[*]Each Chapter Break can be individually enabled or disabled[/*]
[*]The clock stops — [b]not the game[/b][/*]
[*]Farming, fishing, mining, combat, NPC activity, and exploration can continue[/*]
[*]Hold [b]T[/b] or click and hold the journal-clock to continue[/*]
[*]Animated journal + clock HUD[/*]
[*]Smooth page-turn animation[/*]
[*]Small predefined atmosphere messages[/*]
[*]Uses Stardew Valley sound effects[/*]
[*]Move and resize the HUD[/*]
[*]Designed to coexist with slower-time / TimeSpeed-style mods[/*]
[*]Optional [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] support[/*]
[/list]

📖 [b]HOW IT WORKS[/b]
Play normally until the game reaches an enabled Chapter Break:
[b]11 AM • 3 PM • 7 PM • Midnight[/b]
When the journal-clock appears, the in-game clock waits.
You can keep playing for as long as you want.
Farm.
Fish.
Mine.
Explore.
Finish talking to people.
Take care of whatever you still wanted to do.
When you’re ready to move on, hold [b]T[/b] for about one second or click and hold the journal-clock.
The page turns.
Time starts flowing again.
And your day continues.


🌿 [b]WHY TIME CHAPTER?[/b]
Big modlists can make Stardew feel surprisingly rushed.
Between farm chores, NPCs, large maps, events, fishing, mining, and everything else, sometimes you just want the game to wait for you for a little while.
Time Chapter gives you those breathing points without turning the entire day into one permanent time freeze.
[i]Don’t worry about the clock.[/i]
[i]Enjoy the valley.[/i]
And when you’re ready...
[b]turn the page.[/b]



📦 [b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b][/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — Optional[/*]
[/list]

💡 [b]COMPATIBILITY / GAMEPLAY CLARIFICATION[/b]
Time Chapter is built around [b]Stardew Valley and SMAPI’s normal runtime systems[/b] and does not depend on any other mod’s content.
Its main job is simple: at an enabled Chapter Break, Time Chapter temporarily holds Stardew Valley’s clock at that time while allowing normal gameplay to continue.
It does not replace NPC dialogue, schedules, maps, machines, shops, weather systems, combat systems, character content, or other source content.
While a Chapter Break is active, Time Chapter keeps control limited to the time pause itself and the small presentation systems belonging to the mod, such as its journal-clock HUD, page-turn effect, and Chapter Break messages.
The atmosphere messages shown by Time Chapter are [b]prewritten messages included with the mod[/b]. They are not generated dynamically at runtime.
Time Chapter is designed to coexist with slower-time / TimeSpeed-style systems. Another mod can control how quickly normal game time moves, while Time Chapter provides its own fixed Chapter Breaks.
If another system legitimately changes the game clock while a Chapter Break is active, Time Chapter is designed to release its hold rather than continually fight the change.
[b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is supported.

🤖 [b]AI DISCLOSURE[/b]
The [b]AI-Generated Content[/b] tag reflects the use of AI assistance during development of Time Chapter, including development of the mod’s code, some written atmosphere messages, and some visual/UI assets.
Some visual/UI assets, including parts of the [b]journal-clock HUD and presentation art[/b], were created with AI generation based on original concepts made specifically for Time Chapter.
Some atmosphere messages were written with AI assistance during development and then reviewed and adjusted for the mod.
The mod itself was designed, tested, balanced, adjusted, and assembled by me.
[b]Time Chapter does not use AI, an LLM, or any other generative system while Stardew Valley is running.[/b]
Chapter Break timing, clock control, HUD behaviour, page-turn effects, configuration, and atmosphere messages are all handled through predefined rules and content included with the mod.
AI does not generate messages, dialogue, NPC behaviour, schedules, events, maps, gameplay decisions, or other content at runtime.
